description: Nexora Button Slicer is an Arabic-first button slicer for Power BI, built with full right-to-left (RTL) support. It replaces the standard dropdown with clear, tappable buttons so users reach the category they need in one click — and it stays readable whether you have five options or five hundred. Key features: - Three view modes: pills, dropdown, and search. - Horizontal or vertical orientation, with RTL-aware scroll arrows, wrap or scroll overflow. - Single and multi-select (Ctrl+click), an optional "All" option, and a clear button. - Count badges per button, with formatting and change animation. - Automatic search box once the list passes a threshold you set, and selected-items-first ordering. - Customizable colors: track, selected button, hover, text (selected and unselected), plus optional dividers. - Reacts to cross-filtering from other visuals while preserving the current selection. - Arabic/English localization and full font control. Everything runs inside your report: no external services, no network calls, no telemetry your data never leaves Power BI. Ideal for: filtering by region, department, product or category; report navigation; and any dashboard that needs a fast, on-brand filter. A full 30-day trial is included. After the trial, all features remain available a small watermark appears until a license is obtained via AppSource.
